description: Redeem share tokens held in your wallet (aCOOK / abCOOK) for the underlying asset. `amount` is in the ASSET (what you want back), or "all" to redeem every share you hold. Limited by the reserve's available liquidity (the rest is lent out). Shares locked as collateral are not in the wallet — use `withdraw_collateral` for those. Simulates first. Requires a signer: COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY locally, or in external-signer mode this returns `needs_signature` for the user's wallet to sign (see submit_signed_tx).

amount.description: UI amount of the asset, or "all"

asset.description: reserve asset: `COOK` or `bCOOK` (case-insensitive), a share-token symbol (`aCOOK`), or a mint

name: withdraw_lend
title: Withdraw from Aera
